status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: The verified rc.16 engine candidate and the site comparison are inlined into server.mjs. npm currently serves the earlier engine rc.15, as recorded on 2026-09-30; this local candidate does not change registry tags. Bundling keeps one copy of the comparison rules.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned draft vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard.

changedSince: rc.1 through rc.15 remain unchanged as separate archives. This candidate bundles engine 0.1.1-rc.16 in place of rc.15. Its three tools and their arguments are unchanged. The engine uses full IAU 2000B nutation; returned positions, angles, cusps and derived values follow that frame. New receipts name nutation and the GeoMoon reduction in moonPosition; earlier supported convention sets remain readable, but a record naming another engine version is not reproduced on this engine and differences remain hypotheses. The adapter still resolves no time zones, performs no searches, and exposes none of the new opt-in calc, window, techniques, houses or sky entry points. Engine and adapter remain unpublished rc.16 candidates; the npm engine version recorded on 2026-09-30 is rc.15.
